description: Emart noise patterns for production-safe parser classification

classification_policy.description: noise classification must be applied only after item_detail, discount_detail, receipt_discount, subtotal, and total checks fail

header_patterns.description: receipt headers and column guide lines
examples: 상품명 단 가 수량 금 액
상품코드 단 가 수량 금 액

seller_info_patterns.description: seller/corner information mixed into item section

safe_guard_rules.name: protect_item_detail_lines
safe_guard_rules.rule: If line matches any item_detail or single_line_item_detail pattern, do not classify as noise

safe_guard_rules.name: protect_item_name_lines
safe_guard_rules.rule: If line matches item_name pattern or text-like product line fallback, do not classify as noise
safe_guard_rules.description: valid product name lines must not be swallowed by noise

safe_guard_rules.name: protect_discount_lines
safe_guard_rules.rule: If line matches discount_detail or receipt_discount pattern, do not classify as noise
safe_guard_rules.description: discount lines must win over noise

safe_guard_rules.name: protect_summary_lines
safe_guard_rules.rule: If line matches subtotal or total pattern, do not classify as noise
safe_guard_rules.description: summary lines must be handled by summary_patterns.json

fallback_policy.description: Only assign noise after all item, discount, and summary classifications fail

output_policy.description: noise lines should remain in parser output for traceability and debugging

parser_notes: Do not classify text-only lines as noise by default because valid item_name lines often contain no numeric structure.
Do not classify summary-like lines as noise before checking summary_patterns.json.
Do not use broad heuristics such as 'non-numeric text means noise'.
Header lines may be split by OCR spacing, so matching should allow loose spacing.
semantic_notes: noise lines are not active semantic targets
noise lines should still be preserved for traceability and debugging
